appearance_facts.fact: Kentucky is filled with the darkest maroon/burgundy color on the map, which corresponds to the top of the legend scale.
Nebraska is filled with a bright red color, which is the second darkest color on the map.
Utah is filled with an orange color, which is lighter than the red and maroon states.
Tennessee is filled with a pale yellow color, which is lighter than the orange state.
New Mexico is filled with a very pale cream/off-white color, which is the lightest color among the highlighted states.
Wisconsin is filled with a light yellow color, similar to or slightly darker than Tennessee.
A vertical color legend bar is located in the bottom right corner, showing a gradient from light cream at the top to dark maroon at the bottom.
